newsitem.title: USA: Federal agents probe Texas electoral fraud claims.
newsitem.headline: Federal agents probe Texas electoral fraud claims.

text.p: Federal agents are investigating allegations of electoral fraud in Dallas County and are focusing on whether non-citizens voted in recent elections here, officials said on Thursday.
U.S. Attorney Paul Coggins said the investigation was at a preliminary stage and the FBI had been called in to help.
"We are conducting a probe to determine if there was voting by non-citizens in recent elections and, if there was, how widespread it was and if it was coordinated," Coggins said.

"If we find it was widespread or that it was coordinated, we almost certainly would expand the investigation and ask the Public Integrity Section of the Department of Justice to get involved," he told Reuters.
Coggins said information pointing to possible voter fraud came from the Immigration and Naturalisation Service, but he declined to give specific details.
